GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

4. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

11. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
